source_certain.method: class-stratified paired patient bootstrap, identical patient draws across ALL arms/seeds; mean of seed-wise macro F1 differences
source_certain.limitations: Conditional on fixed fitted predictions and these seeds. No model refits or seed resampling; no correction for correlated training folds, repeated development or multiple comparisons. Not independent confirmation.

source_positive_intermediate.method: class-stratified paired patient bootstrap, identical patient draws across ALL arms/seeds; mean of seed-wise macro F1 differences
source_positive_intermediate.limitations: Conditional on fixed fitted predictions and these seeds. No model refits or seed resampling; no correction for correlated training folds, repeated development or multiple comparisons. Not independent confirmation.

equal_seed_ensemble_comparison.method: Class-stratified paired patient bootstrap; identical patient draws across all fixed three-seed probability ensembles
equal_seed_ensemble_comparison.limits: Conditional on fixed predictions and two fixed source encoders; no refitting/seed resampling, independent cohort or correction for shared training folds, repeated development or multiple comparisons
